headline: Board clarifies IDF stays at Yellow Line until Hamas fully disarms
dek: Netanyahu publicly rejects Trump's Board of Peace 15-point Gaza proposal — vows no IDF withdrawal before Hamas disarms and rules out a Palestinian state. Board of Peace clarifies withdrawal beyond the 'Yellow Line' happens only after full Hamas disarmament (light weapons, heavy weapons, tunnels).
sources: israelnationalnews.com tag page (bundled headlines, crawled 2026-10-19); Asharq Al-Awsat (phase-two details via Hamas sources)
fault_line: Will Netanyahu defy Trump's Board of Peace — or is the 'rejection' theater while withdrawals are quietly discussed?

sections.what_happened: Netanyahu publicly rejects Trump's Board of Peace 15-point Gaza proposal — vows no IDF withdrawal before Hamas disarms and rules out a Palestinian state. Board of Peace clarifies withdrawal beyond the 'Yellow Line' happens only after full Hamas disarmament (light weapons, heavy weapons, tunnels). Hamas sources tell Asharq Al-Awsat that phase two of the ceasefire spans 210 days in five stages. Mediating nations Qatar, Egypt and Turkey accuse Israel of violating the ceasefire after IDF strikes. Separately, US CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper in Israel for high-level talks on Gaza and regional security (note: Cooper also visited Saturday per KAN/today.az — the two reports may describe the same trip; treat the Monday visit as unconfirmed).
sections.what_verified: Board of Peace terms and Yellow Line condition consistent across multiple INN headlines; Asharq Al-Awsat 210-day figure is single-source via Hamas. INN is a right-wing Israeli outlet — report of Netanyahu's rejection aligns with his stated no-withdrawal-before-disarmament position.
sections.what_disputed: INN's own bundle carries a report that Israeli security officials are discussing limited IDF withdrawals 'despite public pledges' — the public rejection and private discussion diverge. Cooper's 'new' visit may be the recycled Saturday trip.
sections.why_matters: The split, not the bloc: Trump's Board of Peace vs. Netanyahu's red lines. Phase two's 210-day roadmap is on the table; the fault line is whether Israel moves. Note the mediators' (Qatar, Egypt, Turkey) scolding of Israel as evidence the ceasefire is straining.
sections.context: Background: Gaza: Netanyahu rejects Trump's Board of Peace 15-point plan; Board clarifies IDF stays at Yellow Line until Hamas fully disarms; mediators scold Israel

totw_analysis: Our read: The split, not the bloc: Trump's Board of Peace vs. Netanyahu's red lines. Phase two's 210-day roadmap is on the table; the fault line is whether Israel moves. Note the mediators' (Qatar, Egypt, Turkey) scolding of Israel as evidence the ceasefire is straining. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Will Netanyahu defy Trump's Board of Peace — or is the 'rejection' theater while withdrawals are quietly discussed?
